import os, json, re, glob
base = '/online1/ycsc_chenkh/hitici_07/deepseek-harness/attached_files/task_10'

def norm(s):
    return re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', (s or '')).strip()

def get_body_text(f):
    """Extract the key descriptive sentence(s)."""
    ext = os.path.splitext(f)[1].lower()
    txt = open(f, errors='ignore').read()
    # For json, body field
    if ext == '.json':
        j = json.loads(txt)
        return norm(j.get('body',''))[:200]
    # Look for 'Native record' section in md/txt
    if ext in ('.md','.txt'):
        m = re.search(r'## Native record\s*\n+(.*?)(?:\n##|\Z)', txt, re.S)
        if m:
            return norm(m.group(1))[:200]
    # xml: find native_record element
    if ext == '.xml':
        m = re.search(r'<native_record[^>]*>(.*?)</native_record>', txt, re.S)
        if m:
            body = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', m.group(1))
            return norm(body)[:200]
        m2 = re.search(r'<body[^>]*>(.*?)</body>', txt, re.S)
        if m2:
            body = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', m2.group(1))
            return norm(body)[:200]
    # html: strip tags
    if ext == '.html':
        body = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', txt)
        return norm(body)[:200]
    # eml
    if ext == '.eml':
        return norm(txt)[:200]
    # csv: body is in note? just return raw start
    if ext == '.csv':
        return norm(txt)[:200]
    if ext == '.pdf':
        try:
            from pypdf import PdfReader
            r = PdfReader(f)
            body = ' '.join(p.extract_text() or '' for p in r.pages)
            return norm(body)[:200]
        except Exception as e:
            return f'PDFERR {e}'[:60]
    return ''

# For each key, gather the OPE / CUR / APP body
# We know file->(pk,role) mapping from prior parse; re-derive quickly and print bodies for OPE/CUR/APP
from collections import defaultdict
recs = defaultdict(dict)

    txt = open(f, errors='ignore').read()
    pks = sorted(set(re.findall(r'CBP-031-\d+', txt)))
    roles = sorted(set(re.findall(r'(identity_crosswalk|operative_authority|current_operations|approval_and_capacity|correspondence|financial_or_population_support|chronology_and_custody|independent_counterrecord)', txt)))
    role = roles[0] if roles else '?'
    pk = pks[0] if pks else '?'
    body = get_body_text(f)
    recs[pk][role] = (os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(f))+'/'+os.path.basename(f), body)

for pk in sorted(recs):
    print(f"\n=== {pk} ===")
    for role in ['operative_authority','current_operations','approval_and_capacity','identity_crosswalk','financial_or_population_support']:
        if role in recs[pk]:
            fn, body = recs[pk][role]
            print(f"  [{role}] {fn}\n     {body}")

def norm(s): return re.sub(r'\s+',' ', s or '').strip()

def body_of(f):
    ext = os.path.splitext(f)[1].lower()
    t = open(f, errors='ignore').read()
    if ext == '.xml':
        m = re.search(r'<native_record[^>]*>(.*?)</native_record>', t, re.S) or re.search(r'<body[^>]*>(.*?)</body>', t, re.S)
        return norm(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ', m.group(1))) if m else '(none)'
    if ext == '.html':
        t2 = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ', t)
        m = re.search(r'(?:Body|Native Record|Native record|native_record)\s*[:：]\s*(.{0,300})', t2)
        return norm(m.group(1)) if m else norm(t2[:300])
    if ext == '.eml':
        m = re.search(r'(?:Body|Native Record|native_record)\s*[:：]\s*(.{0,300})', t)
        return norm(m.group(1)) if m else norm(t[:300])
    if ext == '.csv':
        m = re.search(r',body,"([^"]+)"', t)
        if m: return norm(m.group(1))
        m2 = re.search(r',subject,([^,\n]+),', t)
        return norm(m2.group(1)) if m2 else '(no body)'
